Krasnoselivka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zaporizhia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Krasnoselivka — founded in 1845 as Jewish Colony Number 3, popularly nicknamed 'Driter Numer' or 'Hirka' ('Bitter') — saw its Jewish residents protected by peasants from the nearby village of Fedorivka during the pogrom wave of May 1881, a notable act of grassroots gentile protection. The community was not as fortunate during the Civil War of 1918–21, when many were killed in a later pogrom. Soon after the German occupation began in October 1941, the 113 Jews still living in Krasnoselivka were murdered.
